# What did each of your books actually earn?

> Free KDP royalty report analyzer for self-published authors: drop in your royalty CSV and see net royalty per book, marketplace and royalty option, refund rates, Kindle Unlimited page reads, delivery costs, a 70% price-band check and what ad spend left. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
